intro: When the team works. Times are Baghdad time, the clock the team keeps.
cap_one: 1 analysis cycle a day, {{every}} from {{first}} to {{last}}.
cap_other: {{count}} analysis cycles a day, {{every}} from {{first}} to {{last}}.
capNone: No analysis cycles run: the last cycle comes before the first.
zoneBehind: Your time zone is {{city}}, {{span}} behind Baghdad. Beside each time is the same moment in {{city}}.
zoneAhead: Your time zone is {{city}}, {{span}} ahead of Baghdad. Beside each time is the same moment in {{city}}.
jobsNote: Each job runs once at its time. The team picks up a change from its next tick, with no restart.

j.news_morning_briefSub: News Intelligence writes the top stories and the 48-hour calendar.
j.historian_regime_tableSub: The Historian labels each instrument trending or ranging, calm or volatile.
j.scout_watchlistSub: Market Scout picks what the team trades today, once both of the above are in.
j.pm_daily_reportSub: The Portfolio Manager sums up the day: trades, P&L, fees and limits used.
j.historian_weekly_reviewSub: The Historian shows which setups and agents made or lost money, and suggests one change.

an.title: Analysis cycles
an.everySub: How often the team looks again at the watchlist and the open positions.
an.firstSub: The first look of the day.
an.lastSub: No new cycle starts after this time.
an.beforeWl: This is before the watchlist at {{time}}, so the first cycles work from yesterday’s picks.

q.title: Quiet hours
q.sub: No new analysis cycles start, and only urgent notifications reach you: circuit breakers, the kill switch, and stops or targets hit.
q.job: The {{job}} at {{time}} falls in quiet hours. It’s still written, but it won’t notify you.
q.cycles_one: {{count}} of {{total}} analysis cycles falls in quiet hours, so it won’t start.
q.cycles_other: {{count}} of {{total}} analysis cycles fall in quiet hours, so they won’t start.
q.note: Open positions keep their stops on OKX through quiet hours.

wk.title: Weekends
wk.label: Stock and ETF perps at weekends
wk.allowSub: Stock perps keep trading while US markets are shut, with thinner liquidity and wider spreads.
wk.noSub: None from Friday {{fri}} to Sunday {{sun}} New York time: {{from}} to {{to}} in Baghdad. Open positions keep their stops.
wk.note: Crypto and commodity perps trade as usual either way.

actNote: Every save is a new version. The agents and the risk engine pick it up from their next tick.

h.created: Schedule created with the default times
h.other: Other settings changed on another page

e.watchlist: The watchlist needs the morning brief and the regime table first. Set it after {{time}}.
e.order: The last cycle has to start after the first one, at {{time}}.
e.every: Use a number of minutes from 15 to 240.
e.quiet: Quiet hours need different start and end times.

savedBody: The team follows the new schedule from its next tick. Nothing needs a restart.
failedBody: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Your changes are still here, so you can try again.
fixFields: Fix the highlighted time and save again.

conflict.title: The schedule changed in another window
conflict.body: Version {{v}} was saved while you were editing, and this page now shows it. Your changes aren’t saved yet:

error.title: Couldn’t load the schedule
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
